name: dao-browser
description: Honor an explicit dao-browser or dao-lite choice; otherwise use Dao Browser for existing tabs and Dao Lite for background web tasks.

interface.shortDescription: Work in the user's Dao browser
interface.longDescription: Honor an explicit dao-browser or dao-lite choice. Otherwise, use dao-browser for existing Dao tabs or windows and dao-lite for searches and background web tasks with your sign-ins. You can watch, take over, or stop background tasks from the sidebar.
defaultPrompt: Use dao-lite to open https://example.com in a background task and report its title.
